ASCII Markdown characters are escaped when escapeAscii is true

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"escape_ascii\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Text with # hash and [brackets] and * star</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
